_doc: fc-system2-003 (web, web_search with query reasoning): the user asks for the latest stable Rust release. The model has to construct a query that returns recent results — phrasing matters (e.g. 'latest stable Rust release' vs 'Rust 1.x release notes' vs 'Rust current version'). The reasoning required: query-phrasing skill. Single web_search tool exposed so the 4-bit model fits thought + call in 512 tokens. The query arg carries command_equivalents (6 accepted phrasings) — queries are the most variable string arg type in the suite and would otherwise fail under strict arg-equal (review of PR #34, M1).
prompt: Search the web for the most recent stable release of the Rust programming language. I want the version number and the release date.
system: Before answering, write your reasoning inside a <thought>...</thought> block. Then call the tool using the <tool_call> format.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Run a web search query and return the top 5 results as a JSON array of {title, url, snippet}.

calls.name: web_search
command_equivalents: most recent stable release of Rust
